category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: Setup ends by naming the next step
history.description: Setup finishes by printing the route from an empty ledger to a first edition in order — survey the codebase, check it, cut the baseline, build — so the sequence doesn't have to be looked up, and the ledger doesn't sit empty because it wasn't clear what came next.
history.dev_notes: The trailing `out()` block in cmdInit; the baseline-date placeholder honours --baseline-date when given.
